title: Sample distributions under null and alternative hypotheses

cues.en: Instructor: Let's continue our discussion of distribution.
cues.zh: 講師：繼續討論分布。

cues.en: So distributions of sample estimates under our different hypothesis, under the null hypothesis and the alternative hypothesis.
cues.zh: 也就是不同假設下，虛無假設與對立假設下，樣本估計值的分布。

cues.en: That is going to tie together a lot of concepts that I introduced you to in the previous section so section on probability.
cues.zh: 這會把上一章，也就是機率章介紹的很多概念串起來。

cues.en: And you're going to see this remarkable, remarkable thing in this video that there is this kernel, this skeleton,
cues.zh: 這部影片會看到一件很驚人的事，有一個核心、一個骨架，

cues.en: this fundamental structure, and it relates to distributions under null and alternative hypotheses.
cues.zh: 一個根本結構，和虛無、對立假設下的分布有關。

cues.en: And that kernel is the basis of all inferential statistics.
cues.zh: 這個核心是所有推論統計的基礎。

cues.en: Pretty much every single statistic that you will ever encounter can really be watered down to or conceptualized as this fundamental thing
cues.zh: 幾乎所有會遇到的統計量，都能歸結為，或用這個根本概念來理解，

cues.en: that I'm going to tell you about towards the end of this video.
cues.zh: 影片後段會介紹。

cues.en: It's pretty exciting, isn't it?
cues.zh: 很令人興奮，對吧？

cues.en: Okay, so before getting into it, I just wanna have a quick reminder of a concept from the central limit theorem.
cues.zh: 開始前，快速複習中央極限定理的一個概念。

cues.en: And the idea there was that we have a population, but in most cases, in nearly all cases, we cannot actually measure the population parameter.
cues.zh: 我們有一個母體，但大多數，幾乎所有情況，都無法實際測量母體參數。

cues.en: That's because it's either impossible or infeasible to measure the entire population.
cues.zh: 因為量測整個母體，不是不可能，就是不可行。

cues.en: So instead, what we do is sample from that population and then we compute some estimate, some parameter estimate from that sample, for example, the mean.
cues.zh: 所以改從母體抽樣，再由樣本計算某個估計值、參數估計值，例如平均值。

cues.en: So, and then what we can do is sample from that population over and over again.
cues.zh: 接著，可以一再從母體抽樣。

cues.en: We can repeat the sample over and over again, and we don't get the same exact value for that sample estimate with each individual sample.
cues.zh: 重複抽樣，每個個別樣本得到的估計值，不會完全相同。

cues.en: So each sample is going to give a value that's sort of close, they're gonna be in the same range, but they're never identical because of sampling variability.
cues.zh: 每個樣本值都大致接近、落在相同範圍，但因為抽樣變異，不會完全一樣。

cues.en: And then you get this distribution of sample means.
cues.zh: 於是得到樣本平均值的分布。

cues.en: So with that in mind, let us ask a scientific question.
cues.zh: 記住這點，再問一個科學問題。

cues.en: Are giraffes taller than giraffes?
cues.zh: 長頸鹿比長頸鹿高嗎？

cues.en: Now, you may look at this slide and be slightly puzzled, or maybe you're a little bit concerned about whether I'm starting to finally go senile and lose my marbles.
cues.zh: 看到這張投影片，也許有點困惑，或者擔心我終於開始老糊塗、失去理智。

cues.en: But this is the real question, are giraffes taller than giraffes?
cues.zh: 但問題真的是，長頸鹿比長頸鹿高嗎？

cues.en: Now it's a stupid question.
cues.zh: 這是個愚蠢的問題。

cues.en: Obviously the answer is no, it's not even a sensible question, but this is the null hypothesis question that we are asking here.
cues.zh: 顯然答案是否，甚至不是合理問題，但這就是這裡提出的虛無假設問題。

cues.en: And the reason why I'm setting up this question is to illustrate how to create a distribution under the null hypothesis, a distribution of effects
cues.zh: 這樣設定，是為了示範如何在虛無假設下建立分布，也就是效果的分布，

cues.en: or sample parameter estimates under the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 或虛無假設下樣本參數估計值的分布。

cues.en: Okay, so let's imagine this is the entire population of giraffes.
cues.zh: 假設這是整個長頸鹿母體。

cues.en: Again, we cannot measure the entire population of giraffes.
cues.zh: 同樣，無法測量全部長頸鹿。

cues.en: So instead what we do is we draw a random sample.
cues.zh: 所以改抽隨機樣本。

cues.en: So we go to our population, we draw one random sample of giraffes and then we get another random sample of giraffes.
cues.zh: 從母體抽一個長頸鹿隨機樣本，再抽另一個。

cues.en: We measure all the heights, take the averages and subtract them.
cues.zh: 測量所有身高，取平均，再相減。

cues.en: And in this case, we happen to get a difference of heights between these two samples of 0.2 meters.
cues.zh: 這次兩個樣本的身高差剛好是 0.2 公尺。

cues.en: Now, what does that mean?
cues.zh: 這代表什麼？

cues.en: Does that mean that giraffes are actually 0.2 meters taller than giraffes?
cues.zh: 代表長頸鹿真的比長頸鹿高 0.2 公尺嗎？

cues.en: No, it doesn't mean that.
cues.zh: 不是。

cues.en: It means that this group of giraffes, this sample happened to be a little bit taller than this sample, and that just happened by chance.
cues.zh: 表示這群長頸鹿，這個樣本，剛好比另一個樣本高一點，只是偶然。

cues.en: It happened because of sampling variability, noise, individual differences, all sorts of reasons why we might have gotten this difference.
cues.zh: 由於抽樣變異、雜訊、個體差異，各種原因，都可能得到這個差異。

cues.en: So the point here is that we expect that this difference is exactly zero meters.
cues.zh: 重點是，預期差異恰好為 0 公尺。

cues.en: That's kind of the expected value here.
cues.zh: 這算是這裡的期望值。

cues.en: But in practice, when we are taking samples of the data, we don't really expect every single sample to have a difference of exactly zero
cues.zh: 但實際抽樣時，不會預期每個樣本差異都恰好為 0，

cues.en: because of all sorts of causes of sampling variability.
cues.zh: 因為有各種抽樣變異來源。

cues.en: So instead, we are willing to tolerate some distribution around zero.
cues.zh: 所以願意容許在 0 附近有某種分布。

cues.en: So it could look something like this.
cues.zh: 可能像這樣。

cues.en: So we get a sample A of giraffes and sample B of giraffes, and then we expect that their height difference is zero
cues.zh: 取得長頸鹿樣本 A 和樣本 B，預期身高差為 0，

cues.en: but we're willing to accept that there will be some unusual sample where group A is taller than group B.
cues.zh: 但願意接受，某些不尋常樣本中，A 組比 B 組高。

cues.en: It's just gonna happen by chance.
cues.zh: 純粹偶然就會發生。

cues.en: Okay, so let's call this a distribution of height differences expected under the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 把它稱為虛無假設下預期的身高差分布。

cues.en: So the null hypothesis is true, and this is a distribution that we can expect if the null hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 虛無假設為真，這是它為真時可以預期的分布。

cues.en: Okay and that is the idea of generating these sample estimate distributions under the null hypothesis and under the alternative hypothesis.
cues.zh: 這就是在虛無假設、對立假設下，產生樣本估計值分布的概念。

cues.en: So here we say that this is a distribution of effect sizes that we can expect under the null hypothesis and if the null hypothesis is false
cues.zh: 這是虛無假設下可以預期的效果量分布；如果虛無假設為假，

cues.en: and the alternative hypothesis is true, then this is the distribution that we can expect.
cues.zh: 對立假設為真，則可以預期這個分布。

cues.en: So this would be the alternative hypothesis distribution, and this is the null hypothesis distribution here.
cues.zh: 這是對立假設分布，這邊是虛無假設分布。

cues.en: So then what we want to know, we want to come up with some probability that these two distributions are different from each other.
cues.zh: 接著想知道，想求出某種機率，判斷兩個分布是否不同。

cues.en: So because you could, you know...
cues.zh: 因為可能……

cues.en: Because there's stochasticity, there's some randomness, you could get an alternative hypothesis distribution that looks a little bit different from the null hypothesis distribution
cues.zh: 因為有隨機性，可能得到看起來和虛無假設分布稍有不同的對立假設分布，

cues.en: but the difference is actually just due to more sampling variability, more noise.
cues.zh: 但差異其實只是更多抽樣變異、更多雜訊造成。

cues.en: This one, in this particular case, they look pretty far away.
cues.zh: 這個特定情況，看起來距離相當遠。

cues.en: They overlap. So they're not perfectly non-overlapping.
cues.zh: 有重疊，所以不是完全不重疊。

cues.en: They overlap a bit here, but they do look reasonably far away.
cues.zh: 這裡有些重疊，但看起來相當遠。

cues.en: Okay, so we need a normalized way to understand or to quantify the difference between the null hypothesis distribution
cues.zh: 因此，需要正規化的方式，理解或量化虛無假設分布

cues.en: and the alternative hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 和對立假設分布的差異。

cues.en: And the way we go about doing that is by quantifying the difference of the centers of these distributions, so the means of these two distributions.
cues.zh: 做法是量化分布中心的差異，也就是兩個分布平均值的差異。

cues.en: But that's not really sufficient on its own, in part because that difference of centers is going to be scale dependent.
cues.zh: 但單靠這點不夠，一部分原因是，中心差異取決於尺度。

cues.en: So in our case of giraffes, this difference here is in meters.
cues.zh: 在長頸鹿例子中，這個差異以公尺表示。

cues.en: But that's difficult because then, if we would go back and measure it in centimeters or in feet or in light years, we would have different numbers for these statistics,
cues.zh: 這會有問題，因為改成公分、英尺或光年，就會得到不同統計數值，

cues.en: and we want all of these inferential statistics to be unitless.
cues.zh: 而我們希望推論統計量都沒有單位。

cues.en: Okay, so that's one issue with just quantifying the difference of the centers.
cues.zh: 這是只量化中心差異的一個問題。

cues.en: The other issue is that the width of these distributions is pretty important.
cues.zh: 另一個問題是，分布的寬度也很重要。

cues.en: You can imagine if these distributions were really wide like this, this would be the null hypothesis distribution and the alternative hypothesis distribution
cues.zh: 想像分布非常寬，像這樣，這是虛無假設分布，而對立假設分布

cues.en: would also be really wide like this.
cues.zh: 也像這樣很寬。

cues.en: Now, these two distributions are so wide that they're almost perfectly overlapping with each other, even though the means are still this much different.
cues.zh: 那兩個分布就寬到幾乎完全重疊，即使平均值仍相差這麼多。

cues.en: And you can imagine that the other way, imagine these two distributions were narrower than they would overlap much less, and then we could be even more confident
cues.zh: 反過來，如果分布更窄，重疊就少很多，也能更有信心

cues.en: that the alternative hypothesis distribution is different from the null hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 認為對立假設分布和虛無假設分布不同。

cues.en: Okay, so for those reasons, we need this difference of centers to be scaled by or normalized by some feature of the widths of these distributions.
cues.zh: 因此，需要用分布寬度的某個特徵，縮放或正規化中心差異。

cues.en: So that's accounting both for the scale, because now you have centimeters and centimeters in the numerator and the denominator, so the scale will cancel.
cues.zh: 這同時處理尺度問題，因為分子、分母都是公分，單位就會消掉。

cues.en: And you also have the normalization by the width of these distributions.
cues.zh: 也透過分布寬度進行正規化。

cues.en: Now, I don't want you to take this too literally, because different kinds of statistics will quantify these widths in slightly different ways.
cues.zh: 不要太字面理解，因為不同統計量，量化寬度的方式會稍有不同。

cues.en: So the point here is not to get too formal, the point here is to actually stay relatively informal and just present this as a general framework.
cues.zh: 這裡重點不是太形式化，而是保持相對非正式，作為一般架構。

cues.en: And specific kinds of statistical tests are going to adopt this basic equation in a different way.
cues.zh: 特定統計檢定，會以不同方式採用這個基本方程式。

cues.en: So the difference of centers normalized by the widths of the distributions, I'm actually going to relabel that as some characteristic of signal divided by some characteristic of noise.
cues.zh: 把中心差異除以分布寬度，我要重新稱為某種訊號特徵，除以某種雜訊特徵。

cues.en: So we call this the signal, and we call this width here, this dispersion, something about noise.
cues.zh: 這叫訊號，寬度、離散程度，則是某種雜訊。

cues.en: So effectively what we're doing is saying that null hypothesis testing and hypothesis testing
cues.zh: 實際上是在說，虛無假設檢定與假設檢定，

cues.en: is really all about quantifying some signal to noise ratio.
cues.zh: 其實都是量化某種信噪比。

cues.en: And this right here is the basis of all inferential statistics that is pretty powerful that basically the entire field of statistical inference
cues.zh: 這就是所有推論統計的基礎，相當有力，基本上整個統計推論領域，

cues.en: with all its bazillion different methods, parameters, simulation software, essentially every single thing
cues.zh: 不管有多少方法、參數、模擬軟體，幾乎所有事物，

cues.en: in inferential statistics is really just evaluating or can be boiled down to this fundamental kernel, which is a signal to noise ratio,
cues.zh: 都在評估，或者能歸結到這個根本核心，也就是信噪比，

cues.en: and it's a signal to noise ratio of some effect versus some null hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 某種效果相對於某個虛無假設分布的信噪比。

cues.en: Now that's a very general statement.
cues.zh: 這是非常一般性的說法。

cues.en: You will see that the T-test, the correlation, and (indistinct) regression, logistic regression, all sorts of different kinds of analyses are going to
cues.zh: 你會看到，t 檢定、相關，以及〔此處語音不清〕迴歸、邏輯斯迴歸，各種分析，都會

cues.en: interpret this in different ways and add things on and sort of make this very complicated.
cues.zh: 用不同方式解讀，加入其他東西，讓它變得很複雜。

cues.en: But I want you to keep this in mind, I want you to think about every statistical analysis as being fundamentally just a signal to noise ratio
cues.zh: 但請記住，每種統計分析，根本上都可以想成信噪比，

cues.en: that gets adopted to these specific type of data and types of assumptions, different ways of generating this null hypothesis distribution and so on
cues.zh: 再針對特定資料類型、假設、產生虛無假設分布的不同方式等等調整，

cues.en: but they're all basically boiled down to a signal to noise ratio.
cues.zh: 但基本上都歸結到信噪比。

cues.en: So in this video you learned about distributions of sample estimates under the null hypothesis and under the alternative hypothesis.
cues.zh: 這部影片學到虛無假設與對立假設下，樣本估計值的分布。

cues.en: And you learned that the basis of all inferential statistics is really just a signal to noise ratio.
cues.zh: 也學到，所有推論統計的基礎，其實就是信噪比。
